# Version 4.153.0
> **Skia m153 engine update** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.153.0-rc.1.26456.2)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.153.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.300/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.153.0 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m153. Linux font fallback can now select a different fontconfig face; use an explicit family, style, or bundled typeface when exact selection matters.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone m153** — Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 153 and incorporates upstream m153 bug fixes. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826), [#4927](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4927))
- **Linux font fallback behavior updated** — Font fallback now tries FcFontMatch before the previous FcFontSort path, which can select a different face and change text metrics or glyphs for applications that rely on fontconfig fallback. ([#4826](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4826))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.300

No HarfBuzzSharp binding changes shipped in this release — it rebuilds the same HarfBuzz as the previous line.
